title.b: My Heart Will Praise You, Lord

meta.author:
讚美之泉
詞、曲：曾祥怡 Grace Tseng

lines.a: 全心感謝 全心讚美 進入祢的院
lines.b: With all my heart, I will give thanks and enter Your court

lines.a: 全心頌讚 獻上為祭 是嘴唇的果子
lines.b: Offering my praise to You, Lord, It's the fruit of my lips

lines.a: 在祢裡面 一無罣慮 喜樂滿溢
lines.b: In Your presence, free of worries, joy overflows

lines.a: 常常感謝 不住禱告 盼望在於祢
lines.b: Always grateful, always praying, my hope is in You

lines.a: 我要全心讚美 跳舞頌揚祢名
lines.b: My heart will praise You, Lord, I'll dance before Your throne

lines.a: 在祢殿中一日 勝過在世上千日
lines.b: One day with You is better than a thousand elsewhere

lines.a: 我要全心讚美 讚美還要讚美不停
lines.b: My heart will praise You, Lord, I'll never stop praising Your name

lines.a: 義人棚裡 歡呼聲永不息
lines.b: The righteous will declare Your victory
